name: pl_fixtures_by_matchweek
description: Fetch Premier League fixtures for a given competition, season, and matchweek from the Pulselive v1 matches endpoint via top-level navigation.

operations.js: (() => { try { const text = document.body && document.body.innerText ? document.body.innerText : null; if (!text) { return { ok: false, error: 'No body text found' }; } const parsed = JSON.parse(text); return { ok: true, value: parsed }; } catch (e) { return { ok: false, error: String(e) }; } })();

parameters.name: competitionId
parameters.description: Competition ID as used by Pulselive (e.g., 8 for Premier League).

parameters.name: seasonId
parameters.description: Season ID as used by Pulselive (e.g., 2025 for 2025/26 season).
